heading: Separability of certain provisions of this chapter
lead: The provisions of this chapter limiting the insurance of the deposits of any depositor to a maximum less than the full amount shall be independent and separable from each and all of the provisions of this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Section is derived from subsec. (z) of former section 264 of this title. See Codification note set out under section 1811 of this title.
